name: heart
definition: Blood pumping organ composed of four components: sinus venosus, atrium, cardiac ventricle and bulbus arteriosus.
overrideNote: DM-24: the heart is one record from the heart rudiment at 19 hpf; the alias chain names the earlier ZFIN heart terms; ZFA starts the heart at High-pec (42 hpf). Handoff heart_cone_tube runs inside the record (22 to 24 hpf); handoff heart_tube_chambers seeds atrium, cardiac ventricle, bulbus arteriosus and sinus venosus over 42 to 48 hpf and the heart mesh ends at 48 hpf (geometryEndHpf) while the record continues as their parent; the app keeps the loop mesh while the chamber records are derived parts (handoffFallback). The zebrafish heart has two chambers; the sinus venosus and the bulbus arteriosus are inflow and outflow segments, so the model draws four parts and not four chambers. DM-36: axis clamp at 4320 hpf.

events.text: Bilateral cardiac fields present at the 5-9 somite stage (heart primordium).
First cardiomyocyte differentiation (myl7) at the 14-somite stage.
The heart cone forms between 19.5 and 22 hpf (heart rudiment).
Leftward jog of the extruding tube, 21 to 23 hpf.
Heart beat begins (D8).
Circulation begins (D8).
Heart looping begins (D8); the tube is straight before 30 hpf.
Looping under way; the ventricle is displaced toward the midline.
ZFA start of the heart term (High-pec): the four parts can be named. The zebrafish heart has two chambers; the sinus venosus and the bulbus arteriosus are inflow and outflow segments.
Looped heart with atrium and ventricle separated by the AV canal; 231 ventricular cardiomyocytes.
Looping and chamber ballooning complete.
The epicardium spreads over the myocardium.
Endocardial cushions differentiate into valve leaflets.
Terminal rotation done by SL 3.6 mm: the atrium moves behind the ventricle.
Adult: ventricle length 4.28 percent of SL, width to length ratio 0.83.

The raised anchor keeps every vertex inside (tests/unit/anatomy-a3.test.ts).

from 720 hpf the venous pole moves to u 0.28, v -0.5 (review R06): the adult heart lies in the pericardial cavity behind the gill basket and the cleithrum (u 0.27), ventral to the isthmus, not under the eye; the aortic arch array (u 0.16 to 0.24) then lies anterior to it

name: dorsal aorta
definition: Principal unpaired, median artery of the trunk, leading from the paired roots (radices) of the dorsal aorta to the caudal artery.

events.text: Angioblasts migrate to the midline and form the vascular cord (ZFA:0005077, 14-19 somites).
The lateral dorsal aortae join into one vessel on each side around 20 hpf.
ZFIN start (26+ somites): single dorsal aorta tube in the trunk.
Primary intersegmental sprouts leave the dorsal aorta from about 22 hpf.
Circulation starts at 26 hpf (D8); the aorta is renamed caudal artery where it enters the tail.
Hematopoietic stem cells emerge from the ventral aortic floor from Prim-15 (ZFA:0009014 start).
Vascular smooth muscle cells appear on the mid-trunk aorta by 3 dpf.

name: aortic arch
definition: Artery that is part of the pharyngeal arches.

events.text: Aortic arch 1 appears at the start of the pharyngula period; it carries the first circulation from 26 hpf (D8).
Aortic arches 3 and 4 form (ZFIN start Long-pec); the whole series of six pairs carries blood early in the hatching period.
All aortic arches are lumenized and carrying blood flow by 50 hpf on average (Anderson et al. 2008 Dev Biol 318:258-267 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2483962/).
ZFIN start of aortic arches 5 and 6 (Pec-fin).
Aortic arch 2 is vestigial and ends at Pec-fin.
Arches 3-6 persist as the afferent and efferent branchial arteries of the four gill arches.

name: common cardinal vein
definition: Bilaterally paired longitudinal vein; the anterior cardinal returns blood from the head, and the posterior cardinal returns it from the trunk; these two vessels join together on each side as the common cardinal vein (duct of Cuvier; misnamed the vitelline vein) that leads across the yolk cell to the heart's sinus venosus.

events.text: Venous angioblast population specified about 17 hpf.
ZFIN start (20-25 somites).
Endothelial cells migrate as a monolayer over the yolk syncytial layer from about 20 hpf.
An open-ended lumenized cylinder forms by 26 hpf.
The endothelial sheet closes around the lumen (lumen ensheathment).

sizes.source: research 03c (estimate); estimate; an open-ended lumen forms by 26 hpf (Helker et al. 2013, Development 140:2776-2786, https://journals.biologists.com/dev/article/140/13/2776/76627)

Phase 2 visual calibration (RN-06): from 22 to 60 hpf the duct of Cuvier is drawn as a thin plate over the yolk, 0.06 of the axis long, 0.115 of the local body height tall and 15 um thick, as the vascular reference figure shows it sweeping over the yolk to the sinus venosus.

Phase 2 visual calibration: keyframes that crossed the body outline after the layout pass were seated toward the spine in steps of 1.5 percent, and shrunk in steps of 3 percent only when seating alone did not close the gap, until every vertex builds inside the skin.
